correctness.rationale: Exact 2x2 period transfer gives real characteristic polynomial with determinant a^(2m); all m<=4 cases have negative p_m(1) for every a>0. For fixed m>=5, simple-root perturbation yields dominant eigenvalue 1+(4-m)a^2+O_m(a^4), while second is O(a^(2m)). Special m4 quartic positivity proves threshold minimal. A newly bundled checker independently reproduces characteristic identities and sample spectra.

value.rationale: A structural, infinite-parameter switching threshold: two monotone Lipschitz opposite rotations that are individually small-step stable produce unconditional instability for all one-to-four dwell lengths, while each fixed dwell length from five upward restores exponential contraction. This directly informs the design of periodic-update frequencies and separates frozen stability from switched stability.
